page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-16-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the c4n family. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance is configured with 124.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 7.75 GB per core. The hardware configuration includes two local solid-state drives for local storage, though specific capacity metrics for these drives are not defined. There are no graphics processing units included in this configuration, and it does not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This instance is designed for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity relative to compute resources. Because dedicated vCPUs are allocated, the instance provides consistent processing capabilities without the performance fluctuations associated with shared-core environments. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory density per core makes it a resource-efficient choice for memory-bound applications, minimizing the need to provision excess vCPUs solely to acquire sufficient RAM.

The c4n-highmem-16-lssd is suited for memory-intensive workloads that do not require GPU acceleration. Appropriate use cases include medium-sized databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise applications, and data processing pipelines that benefit from a 7.75 GB per core memory allocation.
